text:
ethan: Noticing a canary regression on ember-v1q-int8: funcall schema failures spike for mixed-language prompts with nested payloads.
mei: Any example traces?
ethan: Router sample (sanitized):
```
{"tool":"create_ticket","args":"{\"summary\":\"Réunion with 李\",\"details\":\"Line1\nLine2\"}\"}
```
olga: Args is double-encoded: outer JSON has args as a string containing JSON. Validator expecting object fails.
evals-bot: ember-v1q-int8-canary | funcall_schema_pass: 60% | baseline fp16: 89% | sample N=300 | top errors: args_stringified(46%), truncated_escape(33%).
mei: Hypothesis: streaming boundary + quantized token sampler breaks multibyte grapheme clusters; model emits escaped unicode sequences which are then wrapped as a literal by postprocess.
ethan: Short-term mitigation: validator should attempt one-level unescape when args is string starting with { or [ and size < 300KB; emit telemetry tag "soft_unwrap". Also add control-char check.
olga: Also we saw duplicate tool calls because client retries on parse error before dedupe window. Suggest idempotency key on funcalls and defer retry until validator ack.
infra-bot: deploy queued: ember-int8-softunwrap-2026-03-23 by ethan -> rolling to 2%
evals-bot: scheduled re-eval in 25m. Capture per-language breakdown and streaming-on/off split.
mei: Long-term: tokenizer/kernel fix to avoid splitting UTF-8/codepoint sequences on stream cuts for quant kernels. I'll file runtime ticket and add fuzz tests with nested arrays + multilang + emojis.
ethan: I'll land the validator patch behind a canary flag and add logging of raw token snippets for up to 50 failures. If schema_pass doesn't recover >=80% we'll rollback the int8 canary.
